abstract: Maintains local employment commitments and community benefit surveys
system_message:
You are the Stakeholder liaison manager (SOC), responsible for maintaining local employment commitments and community benefit surveys for industrial energy performance proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains local employment commitments and community benefit surveys（LOCAL）
information_points.content:
SOC-LOCAL-4OL：For the Direct Steam Thermoelectric Generation Scheme, the local supply chain procurement rate across Tier-2 civil and installation procurement contracts is 35% committed to Scottish SMEs.
SOC-LOCAL-T0C：For the High-Temperature Heat Pump Microgrid Scheme, the local supply chain procurement rate across Tier-2 civil and installation procurement contracts reaches 65% committed to Scottish SMEs.
SOC-LOCAL-P6U：For the Turbine Organic Rankine Cycle Scheme, the local supply chain procurement rate across Tier-2 civil and installation procurement contracts stands at 50% committed to Scottish SMEs.

information_points.title: Apprenticeship placement（APPR）
information_points.content:
SOC-APPR-U7D：Under the Turbine Organic Rankine Cycle Scheme, the local engineering apprentice intake commitment covers 4 positions for paid local vocational apprentices during the first three operational contract years.
SOC-APPR-412：Under the Direct Steam Thermoelectric Generation Scheme, the local engineering apprentice intake commitment covers 2 positions for paid local vocational apprentices during the first three operational contract years.
SOC-APPR-L4J：Under the High-Temperature Heat Pump Microgrid Scheme, the local engineering apprentice intake commitment covers 6 positions for paid local vocational apprentices during the first three operational contract years.
